blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Steel surface defect detection is critical for automated industrial quality control but remains challenging due to subtle inter-class texture differences and pronounced class imbalance. We introduce TEEP-RCNN (Texture-Enhanced Edge-aware Perception Region-based CNN), a two-stage detector built on Faster R-CNN with a Feature Pyramid Network backbone and an improved Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM). Our CBAM adds dropout regularization in the channel attention MLP and batch normalization on the spatial attention branch, reducing co-adaptation and stabilizing gating logits. Training uses a differential learning rate protocol with cosine annealing warm-up, separating update rates for the pre-trained ResNet-101 backbone and the detection head. At inference, predictions are refined via Test-Time Augmentation fused with Weighted Box Fusion (WBF), improving localization stability on elongated and boundary-adjacent defects. On the NEU-DET benchmark across six defect categories, TEEP-RCNN achieves 73.3% mAP@50 and 37.9% mAP@50-95 in only 10 training epochs on a single GPU, competitive with YOLOv11m (76.2% mAP@50, 100 epochs) while outperforming it on the rolled-in-scale category under the COCO metric. Per-class analysis shows the spatial attention branch is most effective on elongated texture defects such as patches and scratches, while crazing remains an open challenge across both paradigms due to its distributed non-local texture structure.
blocks.zh: 钢质表面缺陷检测对工业自动化质量控制至关重要,但由于细微的阶级间纹理差异和明显的阶级不平衡,检测工作仍然具有挑战性. 我们引进了基于CNN的TEEP-RCN(Texture-Ennected Edge-aware Perception Region),这是在更快的R-CNN上搭建的两阶段探测器,带有一个特质金字塔网络主干线,并改进了CBAM(CBAM)。 我们的CBAM在频道注意力MLP和空间注意力分支的批量正常化中增加了退学规范化,减少了协同适应,稳定了吉卜赛对数. 训练使用异位学习速率协议与余弦肛热热,将预训的ResNet-101主干线和检测头的更新速率分开. 推论,通过试验-时间增强与加权箱融合(WBF)结合,改进了预测,在较长和边界相邻的缺陷上改进了本地化稳定性。 在NEU-DET基准中,TEEP-RCNN在一个单一的GPU上只有10个培训时,实现了73.3% mAP@50和37.9% mAP@50-95,与YOLOv11m(76.2% mAP@50,100 epocs)竞争,同时在COCO度量下在滚动规模类别上表现优异。 每类分析显示,空间关注分支在诸如补丁和刮痕等长纹缺陷上最为有效,而疯狂则因其分布的非局部纹理结构,仍然是贯穿两个范式的公开挑战.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Hot-rolled steel strip is one of the most widely manufactured structural materials globally, with annual production volumes exceeding one billion metric tons. Surface defects introduced during the rolling, cooling, and descaling stages, such as crazing, inclusions, patches, pitted surfaces, rolled-in scale, and scratches, represent a persistent quality problem. Industry estimates suggest that surface defects account for a significant fraction of downstream manufacturing rejects and rework costs, and that even a modest improvement in detection accuracy at the strip inspection stage can prevent material wastage and reduce recalls of formed components. Traditional online inspection relies on human operators visually monitoring steel strips at line speeds between 5 and 30 meters per second, a task where fatigue-induced missed detections are well documented. Automated machine vision systems therefore represent a practical necessity rather than an optional optimization.
blocks.zh: 热滚钢条是全球制造最广泛的结构材料之一,年产量超过10亿公吨. 滚动、冷却和降级阶段中引入的表面缺陷,如疯狂、包容、补丁、坑面、滚入尺度和刮痕,是一个持续的质量问题。 行业估计表明,表面缺陷占下游制造拒绝和再造成本的相当一部分,即使脱衣检查阶段探测精度略有提高,也能防止材料浪费,减少对成型部件的召回. 传统的在线检查依靠人类操作者以每秒5至30米的行速对钢条进行视像监测,而疲劳引发的误检任务有详细记载. 因此,自动机器视觉系统是一种实际需要,而不是一种可选的优化。

blocks.en: Early automated methods used hand-crafted feature extractors tailored to specific defect morphologies. Local Binary Patterns (LBP) [ 1 ] , Gabor filter banks, and wavelet-based texture descriptors capture periodic and directional surface structure and have been shown to discriminate several defect types under controlled conditions. However, these representations require separate parameter tuning for each defect category and mill configuration, and they fail systematically when the illumination conditions or surface finish distribution shifts from the calibration environment. This fragility motivates learning-based approaches that derive representations directly from annotated examples.
blocks.zh: 早期的自动化方法采用了适合特定缺陷形态的手动特征提取器. 本地二进制图案(LBP)[1],Gabor滤波库,以及基于波浪的纹理描述符,捕捉到周期性和方向性的表面结构,并已被证明在控制条件下区分了几种缺陷类型. 然而,这些表示需要针对每个缺陷类别和磨坊配置分别进行参数调试,当照明条件或表面完成分布从校准环境转移时,它们会系统失败. 这种脆弱性促使采取基于学习的做法,直接从附加说明的例子中得出表述。

blocks.en: Deep convolutional neural networks introduced a paradigm shift in this space. Two-stage detectors based on Faster R-CNN [ 2 ] , which pairs a Region Proposal Network (RPN) with a classification-regression head over a shared convolutional backbone, achieved strong localization accuracy on natural image benchmarks and transferred well to industrial inspection tasks via fine-tuning. Feature Pyramid Networks (FPN) [ 3 ] strengthened this pipeline by constructing a top-down multi-scale feature hierarchy, allowing the detection head to simultaneously leverage high spatial resolution from shallow layers and strong semantic content from deep layers. Single-stage detectors such as the YOLO family [ 4 ] removed the proposal generation stage and demonstrated competitive accuracy at substantially higher throughput, making them attractive for real-time deployment.
blocks.zh: 深层次的神经网络在这个空间中引入了范式转变. 基于更快的R-CNN[2]的双级探测器,将一个区域建议网(RPN)配上一个分级后退头,覆盖一个共享的革命骨干,在自然图像基准上实现了强烈的本地化精度,并通过微调将精度转移给工业检查任务. 地物金字塔网络(FPN)[3]通过构建自上而下的多尺度地物分级,使探测头同时利用浅层的高空间分辨率和深层强的语义含量,加强了这一管道. YOLO家族[4]等单级探测器取消了建议生成阶段,并表现出了高得多的吞吐量的竞争精度,使其对实时部署具有吸引力.

blocks.en: Despite these advances, a key gap remains: standard two-stage detectors apply the same generic feature representations to all object categories without differentiating between the distinct texture signatures of different defect types. Crazing, for example, produces a fine-grained crack network that activates across many spatial locations, while scratches produce a narrow high-contrast linear response that is spatially concentrated. A detector that treats these patterns identically at the feature level will necessarily spend proposal capacity and classification confidence on irrelevant background regions.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进步,但仍存在一个关键差距:标准的两阶段探测器对所有对象类别适用同样的通用特征说明,而不区分不同缺陷类型不同的纹理特征。 例如,Crazing产生一个精细的纹理裂缝网络,在很多空间位置上激活,而抓痕则产生空间集中的狭义高连续线性反应. 在特征层面同样对待这些模式的探测器必然会将建议能力和分类信心花在无关的背景区域上.

blocks.en: Attention mechanisms offer a principled solution. The Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) [ 5 ] applies learned channel and spatial recalibration within each convolutional block, allowing the network to suppress uninformative feature channels and focus spatial activation on defect-relevant regions. However, the original CBAM design does not include regularization within the channel attention MLP, which can lead to over-reliance on a small subset of dominant channels, and it applies the spatial attention convolution without normalization, which can produce saturated binary gates early in training. Both issues are particularly consequential on a small-scale industrial dataset like NEU-DET, where the training set contains only 1,224 images after validation splitting.
blocks.zh: 关注机制提供了一个原则性的解决办法。 Cinvolutional Block Recording Module(CBAM)[5]应用每个cinvolutional block内部的学习通道和空间调整,使网络能够压制非信息特征通道,并将空间激活的重点放在与缺陷相关的区域. 然而,最初的CBAM设计并不包括频道注意器内部的规范化MLP,这会导致过度依赖少数占优势的频道,它应用了空间注意的演化而不规范化,在训练初期可以产生饱和的二进制门. 这两个问题对于像NEU-DET这样的小型工业数据集尤其具有影响,在NEU-DET中,培训集在验证分裂后只包含1,224个图像.

blocks.en: This paper presents TEEP-RCNN , which addresses both gaps through two minimal but measurable modifications to the CBAM module, combined with a carefully designed training and inference strategy. The improved CBAM inserts a Dropout layer with rate 0.1 between the compression and expansion layers of the channel attention MLP, and adds Batch Normalization after the spatial attention convolution. These changes add a negligible number of parameters while providing the regularization needed to train a robust attention module on limited industrial data. The training protocol uses differential learning rates with cosine annealing warm-up, and the inference pipeline fuses predictions across test-time augmented views using Weighted Box Fusion.
blocks.zh: 本文件介绍TEEEP-RCNN,它通过对CBAM模块进行两个最低限度但可衡量的修改,加上精心设计的培训和推论战略,解决了这两个差距。 改进后的CBAM在信道注意力MLP的压缩层和扩展层之间插入一个速率0.1的Dropout层,并在空间注意力演化后加入Batch Normalization. 这些变化增加了可忽略不计的参数,同时为在有限的工业数据上培训一个强有力的关注模块提供了所需的正规化。 训练规程采用差分的学习率,并使用余弦内燃热,而推论管道则利用加权箱聚变法,在试验期间增强视图。

blocks.en: The primary contributions of this paper are: 1. An improved CBAM with dropout in the channel attention MLP and batch normalization in the spatial attention branch, applied to the Layer4 bottleneck blocks of a ResNet-101 backbone within a Faster R-CNN two-stage detector. 2. A differential learning rate training protocol combining AdamW with distinct learning rates for the pre-trained backbone and the task-specific detection head, preventing feature degradation in ImageNet-pretrained weights. 3. A WBF-TTA inference pipeline that fuses predictions over test-time augmented views using Weighted Box Fusion, improving localization consistency on elongated defects with variable aspect ratios. 4. A comprehensive comparative evaluation on NEU-DET against YOLOv8l, YOLOv11m, and a vanilla Faster R-CNN baseline, including epoch-by-epoch convergence profiling, per-class breakdown, and model efficiency analysis.
blocks.zh: 本文件的主要贡献是: 1. 改进的CBAM,在信道注意器中停用MLP,在空间注意分支中进行批量正常化,适用于更快的R-CNN两阶段探测器内ResNet-101主干线的Lale4瓶颈区块。 2. 将AdamW与预训骨干和任务特定检测头的不同学习率相结合的差别学习率培训协议,防止ImageNet预训重量中的特征退化。 3. WBF-TTA推论管道在试验期间通过加权箱融合使预测更加清晰,从而改进了对较长的缺陷的本地化一致性和可变侧面比率。 4. 针对YOLOv8l、YOLOv11m的NEU-DET综合比较评价,以及香草更快的R-CNN基线,包括逐个时代的趋同分析、每类分类和示范效率分析。

blocks.en: An improved CBAM with dropout in the channel attention MLP and batch normalization in the spatial attention branch, applied to the Layer4 bottleneck blocks of a ResNet-101 backbone within a Faster R-CNN two-stage detector.
blocks.zh: 改进后的CBAM在信道注意器MLP和空间注意器分支的批量正常化,在更快的R-CNN两阶段探测器内适用于ResNet-101主干线的Lale4瓶颈区块。

blocks.en: A differential learning rate training protocol combining AdamW with distinct learning rates for the pre-trained backbone and the task-specific detection head, preventing feature degradation in ImageNet-pretrained weights.
blocks.zh: 将AdamW与预训骨干和任务特定检测头的特异性学习率相结合的差别学习率培训协议,防止ImageNet预训权重中的特征退化.

blocks.en: A WBF-TTA inference pipeline that fuses predictions over test-time augmented views using Weighted Box Fusion, improving localization consistency on elongated defects with variable aspect ratios.
blocks.zh: 一个WBF-TTA推论管道,在试验期间将预测线导出,利用加权箱融合法增强视野,改进了长期缺陷的本地化一致性,其侧面比率可变。

blocks.en: A comprehensive comparative evaluation on NEU-DET against YOLOv8l, YOLOv11m, and a vanilla Faster R-CNN baseline, including epoch-by-epoch convergence profiling, per-class breakdown, and model efficiency analysis.
blocks.zh: 针对YOLOv8l,YOLOv11m的NEU-DET综合比较评价,以及香草快速R-CNN基线,包括逐个时代的趋同剖面,逐级分解,模型效率分析.

blocks.en: The remainder of the paper is organized as follows. Section II reviews related work. Section III describes the dataset and augmentation strategy. Section IV details the proposed method. Section V presents experimental results. Section VI analyzes findings. Section VII states limitations. Section VIII concludes.
blocks.zh: 本文的其余部分编排如下。 第二节审查有关工作。 第三节介绍了数据集和扩充战略。 第四节详细介绍了拟议方法。 第五节介绍实验结果。 第六节分析了调查结果。 第七节规定了限制。 第八节结论。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Traditional Defect Detection
blocks.zh: II-A 传统的缺陷检测

blocks.en: Early vision-based inspection systems built representations from image processing primitives. Morphological operations combined with adaptive thresholding identified macro-scale defects on relatively uniform backgrounds but were not robust to surface reflectance variation. Song and Yan [ 1 ] proposed a completed LBP descriptor for hot-rolled steel and demonstrated improved illumination robustness by encoding both sign and magnitude transitions of the local texture pattern. Gabor filter banks at multiple orientations captured directional texture energy and found application in distinguishing directional defects such as scratches from isotropic patterns such as pitting. Despite the elegance of these interpretable descriptors, they require separate calibration per defect type and per production line, and their fixed feature vocabulary offers no mechanism for adaptation when the data distribution shifts.
blocks.zh: 早期基于视觉的检查系统构建了来自图像处理原始的表示. 形态学操作与适应性阈值相结合,在相对一致的背景上发现了宏观规模的缺陷,但不足以表面反射变化。 Song and Yan [1] 提出了完成的LBP对热滚钢的描述符,并通过编码当地纹理图案的标志和规模过渡,表现出更高的照明强度. 在多个方向的Gabor滤波库捕捉到方向纹理能量,并发现应用于区分方向性缺陷,如从异色图案中划出的划痕,如夹痕. 尽管这些可解释描述符的优雅,但是它们要求每个缺陷类型和每个生产线分别校准,它们的固定特征词汇在数据分布转移时没有适应机制.

blocks.en: II-B Two-Stage CNN Detectors
blocks.zh: II-B 双层CNN探测器

blocks.en: Girshick et al. introduced R-CNN [ 6 ] , the first method to apply CNN features to object proposals derived from selective search, achieving a substantial accuracy improvement over prior art on the PASCAL VOC benchmark. Fast R-CNN [ 7 ] eliminated redundant convolutions by computing features once over the full image and projecting proposal regions via RoI pooling. Faster R-CNN [ 2 ] replaced selective search with a convolutional RPN that shares features with the detection head, enabling end-to-end training and reducing inference time to near real-time. Feature Pyramid Networks [ 3 ] added lateral connections and a top-down pathway to the backbone, constructing a multi-resolution feature hierarchy that captures both fine-grained edge information in shallow layers and semantically rich representations in deep layers. Mask R-CNN [ 8 ] extended this family with a pixel-level segmentation branch and introduced RoI Align, replacing the quantized RoI pooling with bilinear interpolation for improved spatial precision. These developments collectively established the Faster R-CNN family as the dominant two-stage detection framework and motivated its application to industrial inspection.
blocks.zh: Girshick等人介绍了R-CNN[6],这是将CNN特性应用于对选择性搜索产生的建议书提出异议的第一种方法,比PASCAL VOC基准上之前的艺术有了实质性的准确性改进. Fast R-CNN [7] 通过计算功能一次在全图像上消除了多余的演化,并通过RoI集合投影建议区域. 更快的R-CNN[2]用一个与检测头共享特征的旋律RPN取代了选择性搜索,实现了端对端训练,并将推论时间缩短到接近实时. Feature Pyramid Networks [3] 在骨干上增加了横向连接和自上而下的路径,构建了一个多分辨率特征层次,既捕捉浅层中精细的边缘信息,又捕捉深层中精致丰富的代表. Mask R-CNN [8] 以像素级分块分支扩展了这个家族,并引入了RoI Align,用双线插座取代了量化的RoI集合,以提高空间精度. 这些事态发展共同确立了更快的R-CNN家族作为主要的两阶段检测框架,并促使其应用于工业检查。

blocks.en: II-C Single-Stage Detectors
blocks.zh: II-C 单层探测器

blocks.en: SSD [ 9 ] removed the proposal stage by predicting class probabilities and bounding box offsets directly from multiple feature map scales, achieving a favorable accuracy-speed trade-off. RetinaNet [ 10 ] introduced focal loss to address the severe foreground-background class imbalance inherent in dense single-stage detection, down-weighting easy negatives so that rare, hard foreground instances dominate the gradient. The YOLO line [ 4 ] evolved through numerous architectural revisions. YOLOv8 introduced an anchor-free detection head with decoupled classification and regression branches, a reparameterized convolutional stem, and a refined Mosaic augmentation strategy. YOLOv11 further improved the backbone with C3k2 blocks and SPPF pooling, and the medium variant (YOLOv11m) achieves 76.2% mAP@50 on NEU-DET with only 20 million parameters and 67.7 GFLOPs at inference.
blocks.zh: SSD[9]取消了建议阶段,通过预测类概率和边框直接从多个特征映射尺度中抵消,实现有利的精度-速度权衡. RetinaNet [10] 引入了焦距损失,以解决密集的单级检测所固有的严重前缘-后缘类失衡,减重容易的负数,这样稀有的,硬的前缘例在梯度中占主导地位. YOLO线[4]通过多次建筑修改而演变. YOLOv8引入了无锚检测头与脱钩的分类和回归分支,重塑的转动干,以及精细的Mosaic增强策略. YOLOv11在C3k2区块和SPPF集合上进一步改进了骨干,中位变体(YOLOv11m)在NEU-DET上实现了76.2%的mAP@50,参数只有2000万个,推断时达到了67.7 GFLOP.

blocks.en: II-D Attention Mechanisms in Detection
blocks.zh: 侦查中的注意机制

blocks.en: Hu et al. proposed SENet [ 11 ] , which recalibrates channel-wise responses by learning a global descriptor via global average pooling and a squeeze-and-excitation MLP. This module demonstrated consistent improvements when inserted into residual backbone architectures. BAM [ 12 ] combined channel and spatial attention in a parallel bottleneck design and added the result as a residual to the feature map, providing both local and global refinement. CBAM [ 5 ] applied channel and spatial attention sequentially: first recalibrating feature channels based on global statistics, then refining the spatial activation map using a 7 × \times 7 convolutional gate. The sequential design is computationally lightweight and showed consistent gains over the base architecture on both classification and detection benchmarks including MS COCO. Non-local networks [ 13 ] extended attention to long-range spatial dependencies through self-attention computation, at higher cost.
blocks.zh: Hu等人提议SENet [11],通过全球平均集合和挤压和引用的MLP学习全球描述符,重新校正频道响应。 该模块在插入剩余骨干结构时表现出了一致的改进。 BAM[12]在平行的瓶颈设计中将信道和空间注意力结合起来,并将结果作为剩余部分添加到地物图中,既提供了局部的,也提供了全球的完善. CBAM [5] 应用通道和空间注意依次:首先根据全球统计重新调整特征通道,然后使用7××\time 7 转录门来完善空间激活图. 相继设计在计算上是轻量级的,在包括MS CO在内的分类和检测基准上,在基础架构上显示一致的收益。 非局部网络[13]通过自觉计算,以较高的成本,对长距离空间依赖性给予了关注.

blocks.en: Our work directly extends CBAM by identifying two regularization weaknesses, specifically the absence of dropout in the channel MLP and the absence of normalization in the spatial branch, and correcting them with minimal architectural change. This improves training stability on small datasets without altering the fundamental design philosophy of sequential lightweight attention.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作直接扩展了CBAM,找出了两个规范化的弱点,具体来说就是MLP频道没有停播,空间分支没有正常化,用最小的建筑变化加以纠正. 这提高了小数据集的训练稳定性,同时不改变顺序轻量级关注的基本设计理念.

blocks.en: II-E Transformer-Based and Anchor-Free Detectors
blocks.zh: II-E 变压器和无锁定探测器

blocks.en: DETR [ 14 ] replaced the detection head and post-processing pipeline with a Transformer encoder-decoder and set-based bipartite matching, eliminating anchors and NMS entirely. Subsequent variants such as Deformable DETR [ 15 ] improved convergence speed by restricting cross-attention to a small set of sampled reference points, making transformer-based detection practical at standard training budgets. Swin Transformer [ 16 ] introduced a hierarchical vision backbone with shifted-window self-attention that computes local attention at multiple scales, enabling its use as a drop-in replacement for CNN backbones in two-stage pipelines. On NEU-DET, transformer-based approaches offer strong performance at the cost of larger training budgets and typically require larger datasets for their attention layers to converge meaningfully. DSAT [ 17 ] reports 83.1% mAP@50 on NEU-DET using a dynamic sparse attention mechanism combined with a transformer decoder, establishing the current benchmark state of the art. Our approach achieves 73.3% mAP@50 with a two-stage CNN-based model trained for 10 epochs, which represents a substantially more accessible computational budget.
blocks.zh: DETR [14]用变形器编码器-解码器和设定比对取代了检测头和处理后管道,完全取消了锚和NMS. 随后的变形DETR[15]等变体通过将交叉注意力限制在一小组抽样参考点,使变形器的检测在标准培训预算中成为实用的,提高了趋同速度. Swin Transformer [16] 引入了分级的视野主干线,具有转向窗口自留心,在多个尺度上计算出当地注意力,使得其在两阶段管道中能够用作CNN主干线的倒置替代. 在NEU-DET方面,以变压器为基础的方法以更大的培训预算为代价,提供强大的性能,通常需要更大的数据集才能使其注意力层有意义地汇合。 DSAT[17]在NEU-DET上报告了83.1%的mAP@50,使用动态的稀疏的注意机制与变压器解码器相结合,建立了当前的基准状态. 我们的方法实现了73.3%的mAP@50,为10个世纪培训了一个基于CNN的两阶段模型,这代表着一个更方便使用的计算预算。

blocks.en: II-F Deep Learning for Surface Defect Detection
blocks.zh: II-F 地表缺陷检测深层学习

blocks.en: Tao et al. [ 18 ] demonstrated that CNN-based architectures can reliably classify and localize metallic surface defects across diverse categories when trained with appropriate augmentation, establishing an early baseline for the CNN era of industrial inspection. Bergmann et al. [ 19 ] introduced MVTec AD, a widely adopted anomaly detection benchmark covering 15 industrial object and texture categories, driving advances in unsupervised defect detection and segmentation. Tabernik et al. [ 20 ] proposed a segmentation-based framework that trains end-to-end on weak annotations and demonstrated precise defect boundary localization on the DAGM dataset. He et al. [ 21 ] introduced NEU-DET and showed that hierarchical feature fusion within Faster R-CNN outperforms single-scale detectors for the six-class steel defect task. Subsequent work on NEU-DET has explored deformable convolutions [ 22 ] in the RoI head to improve geometric alignment, graph convolutional reasoning over detected regions, and data augmentation strategies specifically designed for periodic texture patterns. A recurring finding across these works is that crazing and rolled-in scale are consistently harder to detect than patches and scratches, a result our experiments confirm and attribute to the non-local distributed nature of the former defect types.
blocks.zh: 陶等编. [18] 证明基于CNN的架构在经过适当扩增训练后,可以可靠地对不同类别的金属表面缺陷进行分类和定位,为CNN的工业检查时代建立早期基线. 贝格曼等. [19] 引入了MVTec AD,这是一个被广泛采纳的异常探测基准,涵盖15个工业对象和纹理类别,驱动在无监督的缺陷探测和分解方面的进展. 塔贝尼克等人著. [20] 提出一个基于分区的框架,在弱的注释上对端到端进行训练,并在DAGM数据集上显示精确的缺陷边界定位. 他等编. [21]引入了NEU-DET,并显示在S更快的R-CNN内部的分级特征聚变超过了六级钢质缺陷任务的单级探测器. 随后有关NEU-DET的工作探索了RoI头部可变形的演化[22],以改善几何对齐,图解对检测到的区域的演化推理,以及专门为定期纹理图案设计的数据增强策略. 在这些作品中反复出现的一个发现是,疯狂和滚动的规模比补丁和抓痕更难检测,因此我们的实验证实了以前的缺陷类型的非局部分布性质,并归属于这种性质。

blocks.en: III Dataset and Preprocessing
blocks.zh: 三 数据集和预处理

blocks.en: III-A NEU-DET Dataset
blocks.zh: 三-A NEU-DET 数据集

blocks.en: The NEU-DET surface defect database [ 21 ] provides images of hot-rolled steel strips annotated with axis-aligned bounding boxes across six defect categories: crazing (Cr), inclusion (In), patches (Pa), pitted surface (PS), rolled-in scale (RS), and scratches (Sc). Images are captured under industrial line-scan conditions at 200 × \times 200 pixels with controlled but variable illumination. We resize all images to 640 × \times 640 pixels to align with the anchor scales and the ImageNet pre-training resolution of the backbone. The dataset is split into 1,440 training images and 360 test images; we further hold out 15% of training images as a validation set, yielding 1,224 training, 216 validation, and 360 test images.
blocks.zh: NEU-DET表面缺陷数据库[21]提供了在6个缺陷类别:疯狂(Cr),包容(In),补丁(Pa),坑底表面(PS),滚入尺度(RS)和刮痕(Sc)上加注轴线组合框的热滚动钢条图像。 图像在工业线扫描条件下以200x\times 200像素,具有可控但可变的照明. 我们将所有图像的大小调整为 640 ×\times 640 像素,以便与主干线的锚标和ImageNet预训解析一致. 数据集分为1,440个培训图像和360个测试图像;我们进一步将15%的培训图像作为验证集,产生1,224个培训,216个验证,360个测试图像.

blocks.en: Table I shows the per-class bounding box counts in the training split. The dataset exhibits notable imbalance: the inclusion class provides 856 instances while pitted surface has only 351, a ratio of approximately 2.4:1. For context, the six defect categories span distinct morphological regimes. Crazing produces a network of fine surface cracks distributed uniformly across the image. Inclusions are compact, rounded dark spots embedded in the surface. Patches are large irregular regions of surface roughness with diffuse boundaries. Pitted surfaces show small, dense circular cavities arranged in irregular clusters. Rolled-in scale manifests as elongated irregular flakes partially pressed into the surface. Scratches are narrow, high-contrast linear tracks of varying length and orientation.
blocks.zh: 表一显示训练分数中每班的边框数。 数据集显示出明显的不平衡:包含类提供了856个实例,而坑底表面只有351个,比例约为2.4:1。 就上下文而言,六个缺陷类别跨越不同的形态体系。 Crazing生成一个覆盖整个图像的精细表面裂缝分布一致的网络. 包含是紧凑的,圆形的暗点嵌入在表面. 补丁是地表粗糙度的大型不规则区域,具有分散的边界. 坑状表面显示以不规则集群排列的小型密集圆形腔. 滚入的尺度显示为部分压入表面的延长的不规则弹片。 螺纹为狭长,高连续的线性轨道,长度和方向各不相同.

blocks.en: The bounding box statistics reflect these morphological differences. The mean bounding box area is 6,868 pixels 2 with a median of 4,619 pixels 2 on the 640 × \times 640 scale. The mean aspect ratio across all classes is 1.06 with a median of 0.64, indicating a slight skew toward horizontally elongated boxes, driven by scratch and rolled-in-scale instances. Under the COCO object size taxonomy, all boxes in this dataset fall in the medium-to-large range (area > > 32 2 pixels), which explains why the size-stratified metrics in Section V report non-zero values only for medium and large categories.
blocks.zh: 边框统计反映了这些形态差异. 平均边框面积为6,868像素2,中位数为4,619像素2,在640×\times 640比例. 所有类别的平均侧面比为1.06,中位数为0.64,表明略微向横向延伸的箱型倾斜,其驱动力为刮伤和缩放。 在COCO对象大小分类法下,本数据集中的所有框都属于中到大范围(面积 > 32,2像素),这解释了为什么第五节中大小级的度量衡只报告中到大类别的非零值.

blocks.en: III-B Data Augmentation
blocks.zh: 三-B 数据增强

blocks.en: We use Albumentations [ 23 ] for all augmentation operations, applied only during training with bounding box coordinates transformed consistently. Table II details the full pipeline. Geometric augmentations include flips, 90-degree rotations, and shift-scale-rotate transforms, which address the rotational and positional symmetry of defects during manufacturing. Photometric augmentations, including brightness and contrast jitter, gamma randomization, and CLAHE, handle illumination variability common in line-scan cameras. CLAHE with a clip limit of 3.0 is particularly important for pitted surface instances, where low-contrast cavity boundaries benefit from adaptive local contrast enhancement.
blocks.zh: 我们对所有扩增行动使用专辑[23],仅在训练期间适用,其边框坐标一致地改变。 表二详细列出了整个管道。 几何增强包括翻转,90度旋转,以及转向尺度旋转变换,这解决了制造过程中缺陷的旋转和位置对称. 光度增强,包括亮度和对比性振动,γ随机化,以及CLAHE,处理线扫描相机中常见的照明变异性. 剪辑限制为3.0的CLAHE对于凹陷的表面实例特别重要,其中低孔隙边界得益于适应性的局部对比增强.

blocks.en: Structural augmentations such as elastic transform and grid distortion simulate the surface deformation that can occur under different rolling tensions. Coarse dropout and grid dropout train the model to detect partially occluded defects, which arise when one defect overlaps another in dense surface regions. A minimum bounding box visibility threshold of 0.3 ensures that boxes with less than 30% of their area remaining after spatial transforms are discarded rather than retained as noise.
blocks.zh: 弹性变形和电网扭曲等结构增强作用模拟不同滚动紧张状态下可能发生的表面变形. 粗糙的辍学和电网的辍学对模型进行了培训,以检测部分渗漏的缺陷,当一个缺陷在密集的表层区域与另一个缺陷重叠时,就会产生这种缺陷。 0.3的最小边框可见度阈值可确保空间变换后其面积不到30%的盒子被丢弃,而不是作为噪音保留.

blocks.en: All images are normalized with ImageNet mean and standard deviation, consistent with the ResNet-101 pre-training regime. For the extended 200-epoch run, we additionally apply class-conditional loss weights: crazing receives weight 3.0, rolled-in scale 2.5, and scratches 1.5, with the remaining classes at the default weight of 1.0, to partially offset the instance imbalance described above.
blocks.zh: 所有图像均与ImageNet的平均值和标准偏差正常化,符合ResNet-101培训前制度. 对于延长的200世纪跑步,我们额外应用了类条件减重法:crazing得到3.0的重量,滚入2.5的尺度,刮伤1.5,其余的分类默认重量为1.0,以部分抵消上述实例失衡.

blocks.en: IV Proposed Method: TEEP-RCNN
blocks.zh: 四 拟议方法:TEEP-RCNN

blocks.en: IV-A Architecture Overview
blocks.zh: A. 结构概况

blocks.en: TEEP-RCNN is built on the Faster R-CNN two-stage detection framework [ 2 ] with three targeted additions: an improved CBAM module inserted into the ResNet-101 backbone, an anchor configuration tuned to the morphology of steel defects, and a WBF-TTA inference pipeline. Figure 1 shows the complete forward pass.
blocks.zh: TEEP-RCNN以更快的R-CNN两阶段检测框架[2]为基础,并有三项目标:一个经过改进的CBAM模块插入ResNet-101主干线,一个锚定配置以钢质缺陷的形态为调制,以及一个WBF-TTA推导管道. 图1显示完整的前进通道。

blocks.en: Given an input image 𝐈 ∈ ℝ 3 × H × W \mathbf{I}\in\mathbb{R}^{3\times H\times W} with H = W = 640 H=W=640 , the backbone produces a hierarchy of feature maps at four spatial resolutions. The FPN aggregates these into four pyramid levels { P 2 , P 3 , P 4 , P 5 } \{P_{2},P_{3},P_{4},P_{5}\} , each with 256 channels, covering strides of { 4 , 8 , 16 , 32 } \{4,8,16,32\} relative to the input. The RPN generates class-agnostic proposals from each level by applying a shared 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolutional head. Proposals are mapped to 7 × 7 7\times 7 feature grids via Multi-Scale RoI Align [ 8 ] , and the box head produces classification scores and regression offsets. At inference, Soft-NMS and WBF over TTA views refine the final detections.

FPN将这些集合为四个金字塔级 {P2,P3,P4,P5} {P_{2},P_{3},P_{4},P_{5},每个频道有256个频道,覆盖了{4,8,16,32},相对于输入的Q\{4,8,16,32\}. RPN通过应用一个共享的3×3 3\times 3 切换头来生成各个级别上的阶级不可知性建议. 提案通过多比例RoI对齐[8]绘制成7×7 7\时的7特性网格,框头产生分类分数和回归抵消. 在推论中,Soft-NMS和WBF在TTA视图上细化了最终检测.

blocks.en: IV-B ResNet-101 Backbone with FPN
blocks.zh: ResNet-101 带FPN的背骨

blocks.en: The backbone is a ResNet-101 [ 24 ] pre-trained on ImageNet [ 25 ] , with all five residual stage groups set trainable. ResNet-101 provides 23 bottleneck blocks in Layer4 (versus 6 in ResNet-50), giving the CBAM module more activation sites to modulate and a richer semantic feature space at the deepest level.
blocks.zh: 骨干为一台ResNet-101 [24]在ImageNet上进行预训[25],所有5个残存的舞台组都设置了可训练. ResNet-101在Layle4中提供了23个瓶颈区块(ResNet-50中相对6个),使得CBAM模块有更多的激活站点进行调制,最深层的语义特征空间更丰富.

blocks.en: The FPN [ 3 ] builds a top-down pathway by upsampling the Layer4 output and adding it to Layer3 via a lateral 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolution, then repeating this for Layer2 and Layer1. This produces pyramid levels P 2 P_{2} through P 5 P_{5} , each with 256 channels. P 2 P_{2} carries the finest spatial resolution (stride 4) and is most useful for detecting small defect details, while P 5 P_{5} carries the coarsest but most semantically meaningful representation (stride 32) useful for coarse defect localization and size estimation. The FPN design is visualized in Figure 2 .
blocks.zh: FPN [3] 构建自上而下的路径,方法是对Layle4输出进行检测,并通过平面1×1 1\times 1 演化法将其添加到Layle3中,然后为Layle2和Layle1重复. 这产生金字塔级P2P_{2}通过P5P_{5},每个有256个频道. P2 P_{2}携带最先进的空间分辨率(第4步),对探测小的缺陷细节最有用,而P5 P_{5}携带最粗糙但最显眼有意义的代表(第32步),用于粗细的缺陷本地化和大小估计. FPN设计在图2中可视化.

Each P 2 P_{2} – P 5 P_{5} passes a 3 × 3 3\times 3 conv before feeding the RPN and RoI head.

blocks.en: IV-C Improved CBAM Module
blocks.zh: 改进后的CBAM模块

blocks.en: The original CBAM [ 5 ] applies a channel attention gate followed by a spatial attention gate to the feature map of each convolutional block. Our improved version introduces two targeted modifications. Figure 3 illustrates the full module design with both new components highlighted.
blocks.zh: 最初的CBAM [5] 将一个信道的注意门,然后是空间的注意门,用于每个演化块的特征图. 我们的改进版提出了两项有针对性的修改。 图3显示了整个模块的设计,并着重说明了这两个新组成部分。

Dropout in Channel Attention. The channel attention path compresses the spatial dimensions via global average pooling and global max pooling, then passes both through a shared two-layer MLP: 𝐌 c ​ ( 𝐅 ) = σ ⁡ ( W 1 ​ ( Drop ​ ( ReLU ​ ( W 0 ​ 𝐟 ¯ a ​ v ​ g ) ) ) CLOSE OPEN + W 1 ​ ( Drop ​ ( ReLU ​ ( W 0 ​ 𝐟 ¯ m ​ a ​ x ) ) ) ) \mathbf{M}_{c}(\mathbf{F})=\sigma\!\Bigl(W_{1}\!\bigl(\text{Drop}(\text{ReLU}(W_{0}\,\bar{\mathbf{f}}_{avg}))\bigr)\\

blocks.en: Batch Normalization in Spatial Attention. The spatial attention branch concatenates the channel-wise average and maximum projections of the channel-recalibrated feature: 𝐌 s ​ ( 𝐅 ′ ) = σ ⁡ ( BN ​ ( f 7 × 7 ​ ( [ AvgPool ​ ( 𝐅 ′ ) ; MaxPool ​ ( 𝐅 ′ ) ] ) ) ) \mathbf{M}_{s}(\mathbf{F}^{\prime})=\sigma\!\left(\text{BN}\!\left(f^{7\times 7}\!\left([\text{AvgPool}(\mathbf{F}^{\prime})\,;\,\text{MaxPool}(\mathbf{F}^{\prime})]\right)\right)\right) (2) where f 7 × 7 f^{7\times 7} is a single-channel convolution with kernel size 7, [ ; ] [\,;\,] denotes channel concatenation, and BN is Batch Normalization [ 26 ] . Without normalization, the spatial attention logits can vary widely in magnitude across training batches, causing the sigmoid to saturate into near-binary activation maps early in training when the spatial statistics have not yet been learned. Adding BN normalizes these logits before the sigmoid, allowing the gating weights to remain in a soft, gradient-productive regime throughout training. This is especially beneficial on NEU-DET, where batches of size 8 may contain predominantly background-heavy images that produce low-magnitude activations.

blocks.en: IV-D Region Proposal Network and Anchor Design
blocks.zh: IV-D 区域提案网络和锚地设计

blocks.en: The RPN applies a shared 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolutional head over each of the four FPN levels. We define five anchor scales { 16 , 32 , 64 , 128 , 256 } \{16,32,64,128,256\} across the pyramid levels and four aspect ratios { 0.5 , 1.0 , 2.0 , 3.0 } \{0.5,1.0,2.0,3.0\} per level, yielding 20 anchor configurations per spatial position. The fourth aspect ratio (3.0) is a deliberate addition for this dataset: scratches and rolled-in-scale instances frequently produce bounding boxes with aspect ratios between 2.0 and 5.0, and covering this range with an explicit anchor avoids the regression head needing to extrapolate far from the nearest anchor template.
blocks.zh: RPN在四个FPN级别中,每个级别都采用了一个共享的3×3 3\时的3个进化头. 我们定义了5个锚秤 {16,32,64,128,256} {16,32,64,128,256}} 横跨金字塔水平和四个侧面比例 { 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 3.0 } { 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 3.0 } 每个水平, 得出每个空间位置的20个主锚配置 。 第四维度比(3.0)是本数据集的刻意加法:抓痕和在比例尺内滚动的例经常产生带宽比在2.0至5.0之间的边框,用一个明确的锚来覆盖这个范围,可以避免回归头需要从最近的锚模板中远处推断.

blocks.en: RPN training assigns foreground labels to anchors with IoU ≥ 0.7 \geq 0.7 against any ground-truth box, and background labels to anchors with IoU ≤ 0.3 \leq 0.3 . Proposals are filtered with an NMS threshold of 0.4 and a classification score threshold of 0.3, yielding a manageable set of high-confidence proposals that feed the RoI head without excessive noise.
blocks.zh: RPN训练为IoU 0.7\geq 0.7的锚分配前置标签,为IoU 0.3\leq的锚分配背景标签 0.3 (英语). 提案经过过滤后,NMS阈值为0.4,分类分数阈值为0.3,产生一套可管理的高自信提案,供RoI头部没有过度噪音.

blocks.en: IV-E RoI Head and Post-Processing
blocks.zh: IV-E RoI 主管和处理后

blocks.en: Multi-Scale RoI Align [ 8 ] maps each proposal to a 7 × 7 7\times 7 feature grid using bilinear interpolation with a sampling ratio of 2. The FPN level for each proposal is selected based on the proposal area following the formula in [ 3 ] . The box head consists of two fully connected layers of 1024 dimensions each, followed by parallel classification ( K + 1 = 7 K{+}1=7 outputs) and box regression ( 4 ​ K = 24 4K=24 outputs) branches. Detection confidence is thresholded at 0.5, and the per-class box NMS threshold is 0.3, with a maximum of 30 detections per image.

blocks.en: Differential Learning Rate. The model parameters are split into two groups: the ResNet-101 backbone (all layers) and the task-specific components (FPN, RPN, box head). The backbone group receives a learning rate of η backbone = 10 − 4 \eta_{\text{backbone}}=10^{-4} and the task group receives η head = 10 − 3 \eta_{\text{head}}=10^{-3} , a 10:1 ratio. blocks.en: V-B Model Efficiency Analysis
blocks.zh: V-B 示范效率分析

blocks.en: Table IV summarizes the computational characteristics of each model. TEEP-RCNN’s ResNet-101 backbone carries a heavier parameter count (61.8M) than the YOLO variants due to the depth of the residual network and the FPN head. Its estimated backbone FLOPs at 640 × \times 640 are approximately 170 GFLOPs, higher than YOLOv11m’s 67.7 GFLOPs, reflecting the trade-off between depth-driven feature quality and compute efficiency. However, in terms of training epochs to reach 70% mAP@50 , TEEP-RCNN requires only 6 epochs, while YOLOv11m requires approximately 50-60 epochs to reach the same level. This training efficiency matters in practice when labeled data is expensive to collect or GPU-time is limited, as is the case in specialized industrial inspection deployments.
blocks.zh: 表四总结了每个模型的计算特征. TEEP-RCN的ResNet-101骨干承载了比YOLO变体更重的参数计数(61.8M),因为剩余网络和FPN头的深度. 其估计主干FLOP为640 ×\time 640,约为170 GFLOP,高于YOLOv11m的67.7 GFLOP,反映了深度驱动特性质量与计算效率之间的权衡. 然而,在训练时间达到70%mAP@50方面,TEEP-RCNN只需要6个时间,而YOLOv11m则需要约50-60个时间达到同一水平. 这种培训效率在实践中很重要,因为贴有标签的数据收集费用昂贵,或者GPU时间有限,如专门的工业检查部署。

blocks.en: V-C Quantitative Comparison

blocks.en: Table V shows the full comparison including mAP@50-95 and mAR. TEEP-RCNN achieves mAP@50 of 0.733 and mAP@50-95 of 0.379 in 10 training epochs, a training budget 10 × \times smaller than YOLOv11m. This rapid convergence is consistent with the pre-trained ResNet-101 backbone providing strong initial representations and the improved CBAM reducing the number of gradient updates needed before the RPN stabilizes on discriminative defect features.
blocks.zh: 表五显示包括mAP@50-95和mAR在内的全部比较。 TEEP-RCNN在10个培训时代实现mAP@50为0.733,mAP@50-95为0.379,培训预算比YOLOv1100m小10×%. 这种迅速的趋同符合经过预先培训的ResNet-101主干线提供强有力的初步表述,以及改进的CBAM减少了在RPN稳定歧视缺陷特征之前所需的梯度更新数量.

blocks.en: YOLOv11m achieves the highest mAP@50 (0.762) and mAP@50-95 (0.450) after 100 epochs. The gap in mAP@50-95 (0.379 vs. 0.450) indicates that TEEP-RCNN produces slightly looser boxes at tighter IoU thresholds, a pattern consistent with the shorter training duration leaving the regression branch with fewer gradient updates. Notably, the extended 200-epoch TEEP-RCNN run (with class-weighted loss) achieves only mAP@50 of 0.685, below the primary 10-epoch model, suggesting that the aggressive class weighting schedule biases the gradient flow and destabilizes the well-initialized backbone representations. This result demonstrates that the primary model with 10 epochs is already near the optimum for this training configuration.

blocks.en: Table VI traces the epoch-by-epoch progression of training loss and evaluation metrics for the primary TEEP-RCNN model. The total loss drops sharply from 2.755 in epoch 0 to 0.386 in epoch 1 as the RPN begins generating meaningful proposals from the pre-trained backbone features. By epoch 3, mAP@50 reaches 0.429, and by epoch 6 it crosses 0.700. Figure 4 visualizes the loss and mAP@50 curves. The parallel trends of steadily decreasing loss and steadily increasing mAP suggest that the model is consistently improving without signs of the loss-mAP decoupling that can occur when class imbalance causes the regression loss to drive training while classification accuracy stagnates.
blocks.zh: 表六追踪了培训损失的逐年进展和对TPEEE-RCNN模式的评价指标。 总损失从零世纪的2.755降至一世纪的0.386,因为RPN开始从经过预先训练的骨干特征产生有意义的建议. 到时间3,mAP@50达到0.429,到时间6,它跨越0.700. 图4可视化损失和mAP@50曲线. 损失稳步减少和mAP稳步增加的平行趋势表明,模型在不断改进,没有迹象表明在班级不平衡造成回归损失驱动培训而分类准确性停滞不前时,mAP损失脱钩。

blocks.en: The mAP@50 plateau between epochs 8 (0.736) and 9 (0.733) suggests the model is near convergence for this learning rate and epoch budget. The small decrease at the final epoch is within the measurement noise of the COCO evaluation and does not indicate overfitting, as the training loss continues to decline monotonically. This behavior confirms that the cosine annealing schedule successfully reduces the learning rate to a level where the model makes only small, stable weight updates in the final epochs.
blocks.zh: 世纪8(0.736)和世纪9(0.733)之间的mAP@50高原表明,这个模型对于这个学习速度和时代预算来说接近趋同. 最终时期的微小下降是在COCO评价的测量噪声范围内,并不表示过于适应,因为训练损失继续单调下降. 这种行为证实了余弦反射时间表成功地将学习率降低到一个水平,即模型在最终纪元中只做出小,稳定的重量更新.

blocks.en: V-E Per-Class Analysis
blocks.zh: V-E 每类分析

blocks.en: Table VII reports per-class mAP (COCO, averaged over IoU thresholds 0.50:0.95) for TEEP-RCNN and YOLOv11m, enabling a metric-consistent comparison between the two frameworks. Figure 5 provides a visual comparison across all six defect categories.
blocks.zh: 表七报告TEEP-RCNN和YOLOv11m的每类mAP(COCO,平均高于IoU阈值0.50:0.95),使这两个框架能够进行与衡量一致的比较。 图5对所有六个缺陷类别进行了直观比较。

blocks.en: TEEP-RCNN achieves its strongest per-class scores on patches (0.537) and scratches (0.486). Patches produce large, spatially contiguous activation regions that the channel attention readily identifies as dominant texture channels, while the spatial attention focuses on the extended boundary of the patch region. Scratches produce narrow, high-contrast linear activations with a specific directionality that the 7 × \times 7 spatial attention convolution captures efficiently due to its elongated receptive field. Inclusion (0.406) and pitted surface (0.457) achieve mid-range scores consistent with their spatially compact but visually distinctive morphology.
blocks.zh: TEEP-RCNN在补丁(0.537)和刮伤(0.486)上实现了每级最强的分数. 补丁产生大面积,空间毗连的激活区域,信道注意力很容易确定为主纹理通道,而空间注意力则集中在补丁区域的延伸边界上. Scratches产生狭长,高混凝土的线性激活,具有特定的方向性,7 ×\time 7 空间注意力的演化由于它的可接受性场较长而有效捕获. 包容(0.406)和坑面(0.457)达到与其空间紧凑但具有视觉特征的形态相一致的中程分数。

blocks.en: On rolled-in scale, TEEP-RCNN (0.287) marginally outperforms YOLOv11m (0.277), which is a notable result given the 10:1 training epoch ratio. Rolled-in scale produces irregular elongated regions with variable contrast against the background, a structure that appears well-suited to the CBAM spatial attention branch with its aspect-ratio-aware 7 × \times 7 receptive field. This marginal advantage over a single-stage detector trained for 10 × \times more epochs suggests that two-stage detection with targeted spatial attention may have a specific advantage on defect classes with irregular elongated morphology.
blocks.zh: 在滚动规模上,TEEP-RCNN(0.287)的成绩略高于YOLOv11m(0.277),鉴于培训时间为10:1,这是一个显著的成果。 滚入尺度产生不规则的延长区域,与背景形成可变的对比,这个结构似乎非常适合CBAM空间关注分支,其侧面-ratio-aware 7 ×\times 7可接受域. 相对于一个为10xxxx时间更多时段训练的单级探测器来说,这种边际优势表明,具有目标空间注意的双级探测可能对具有不规则长态的缺陷等级具有特殊优势.

blocks.en: Crazing achieves the lowest per-class score for both models (TEEP-RCNN: 0.099, YOLOv11m: 0.148). The structural reason is that crazing fills the entire image with a fine crack network rather than occupying a compact spatial region. The ground-truth annotations for crazing are tight bounding boxes around individual crack clusters, while the model’s proposals and attention maps tend to activate over the full image. This mismatch between the distributed texture and the localized bounding box annotation format is a fundamental challenge for both anchor-based and anchor-free detectors.
blocks.zh: Crazing实现了两种型号的最低每级分数(TEEP-RCNN:0.099,YOLOv11m:0.148. 结构上的原因是疯狂地将整个图像填满一个精细的裂缝网络,而不是占据紧凑的空间区域. 对疯狂的地面真实说明是围绕单个裂缝集群的紧凑的框,而模型的建议和注意力图则倾向于在全图像上激活. 分布式纹理与本地化的边框注解格式之间的这种不匹配,对锚定式和无锚定式探测器都是一种根本性的挑战.

blocks.en: V-F Qualitative Detection Results
blocks.zh: V-F 定性检测结果

blocks.en: Figure 6 shows six representative test images with ground-truth boxes (solid green) overlaid against TEEP-RCNN predictions (dashed red) at the final epoch. The model localizes scratches (Image 1) and crazing (Images 2, 4) with good spatial coverage, and correctly places multiple proposals on rolled-in-scale regions (Images 3, 5, 6) where the irregular elongated morphology produces overlapping ground-truth boxes. Confidence scores visible on prediction labels range from 0.44 to 0.99, indicating that the classification head assigns high confidence to well-localized defects across classes.
blocks.zh: 图6显示六个具有代表性的试验图像,上面有地面真核盒(实绿色),与TEEP-RCNN的预测值(红色)相对照。 模型将抓痕(图1)和抓痕(图2,4)本地化,具有良好的空间覆盖度,并正确地将多个提案放在了滚动的尺度区域(图3,5,6)上,其中不规则的延长形态产生重叠的地面真实框. 在预测标签上可见的置信分数从0.44到0.99不等,表明分类头对不同类别中定位良好的缺陷给予很高的置信度.

blocks.en: The most common failure mode visible in these samples is over-proposal on crazing images (Images 2 and 4), where the model generates multiple partially overlapping boxes across the crack network rather than a single tight enclosure. This aligns with the low per-class mAP for crazing (0.099) and confirms that the challenge is localization precision, not class discrimination.
blocks.zh: 这些样本中最常见的故障模式是过度建议粉碎图像(图像2和4),该模型在整个裂缝网络中产生多个部分重叠的箱,而不是一个单一的紧闭. 这与每个等级的crazing(0.099)mAP的低水平一致,并证实挑战在于本地化精度,而不是阶级歧视.

blocks.en: Fig. 6 : Qualitative detection results on NEU-DET test images. Solid green boxes are ground-truth annotations; dashed red boxes are TEEP-RCNN predictions with confidence scores. The model accurately localizes scratches (Image 1), crazing regions (Images 2, 4), and multiple rolled-in-scale instances (Images 3, 5, 6). Over-proposal on distributed crazing textures is the primary failure mode, consistent with the low per-class mAP for this category.
blocks.zh: 图6:NEU-DET测试图像上的定性检测结果. 坚固的绿色盒子是地面真实的说明;破碎的红色盒子是TEEP-RCNN的预测,有自信的分数. 该模型精确地将抓痕(图像1),抓痕区域(图像2,4),以及多个滚动的缩放例(图像3,5,6)本地化. 关于分布式疯狂纹理的过量建议是主要的失败模式,符合这一类的低级mAP.

blocks.en: Figure 7 shows the per-class mAP heatmap over the extended training run, providing insight into which classes stabilize early versus which fluctuate throughout training. Patches and scratches (warm colors from epoch 10 onward) converge early and remain stable, while rolled-in scale shows persistent variability. Crazing (consistently blue throughout) confirms that no training duration resolves its localization challenge within this architecture.
blocks.zh: 图7显示每个班级的硕士课程在延长培训期间的加热图,从而可以深入了解哪些班级在早期稳定下来,哪些班级在整个培训期间波动。 补丁和刮痕(从10世纪开始的温暖颜色)很早就汇合,保持稳定,而滚入的尺度则显示出持续的可变性. Crazing(始终是蓝色的)证实,任何培训期限都无法解决其在这一架构内本地化的挑战。

blocks.en: Fig. 7 : Per-class mAP heatmap over training epochs (extended run). Warm colors indicate higher mAP. Patches and scratches stabilize early; crazing remains near zero throughout, indicating a structural challenge beyond training duration.
blocks.zh: 图7:每个班级的mAP热图超过训练时代(延长运行). 温暖的颜色表示更高的mAP. 补丁和抓痕很早就稳定下来了;整个过程中的疯狂程度仍然接近零,表明在培训时间之外存在结构性挑战。

blocks.en: VI Discussion
blocks.zh: 六. 讨论情况

blocks.en: Training Efficiency as a First-Class Result. A notable property of TEEP-RCNN observed in this study is its convergence rate. Reaching mAP@50 = 0.700 by epoch 6 and 0.733 by epoch 9 represents a training budget that is 10 × \times smaller than YOLOv11m. This efficiency has two sources. First, the ResNet-101 backbone pre-trained on ImageNet provides strong initial feature representations that immediately generalize to the low-level texture statistics of steel defects, requiring far fewer updates before the RPN starts generating clean proposals. Second, the improved CBAM recalibrates the feature map from the first forward pass, focusing the detection head on defect-relevant spatial positions rather than spending early epochs learning which spatial regions are worth proposing. This combination of transfer learning and targeted attention shortens the effective warm-up period for the detection task itself.
blocks.zh: 培训效率作为一流成果。 本研究观察到的TEEP-RCN的一个显著特征是其趋同率. 达到mAP@50=0.700 到ochode 6,到ochode 9 0.733代表一个训练预算,比YOLOv11m小10×xx时间. 这种效率有两个来源。 首先,在ImageNet上预先训练的ResNet-101主干线提供了强烈的初始特征表述,立即概括到钢质缺陷的低层纹理统计,在RPN开始生成清洁提案前需要更新的要少得多. 第二,经过改进的CBAM从第一个前传重新校正了特征图,将检测头集中在与缺陷有关的空间位置上,而不是在早期学习值得提议的空间区域。 这种转移学习和有针对性的关注相结合的做法缩短了检测任务本身的有效热身期.

blocks.en: Interpretation of the CBAM Attention. While explicit attention map visualization is left for future work, the per-class results provide indirect evidence about what the attention module learns. The strong performance on patches and scratches relative to other classes, and the marginal advantage on rolled-in scale over YOLOv11m, suggests that the 7 × \times 7 spatial attention convolution acquires orientation-selective responses well-suited to elongated and directional defect textures. In contrast, the near-random performance on crazing is consistent with the spatial attention activating broadly across the full image and providing no localization signal above the RPN prior. The qualitative detection examples in Figure 6 confirm this: crazing images show scattered over-proposals rather than a single tight localization, consistent with diffuse spatial attention. A qualitative attention map analysis would either confirm this hypothesis or reveal that the attention module finds a compact proxy signal for crazing (for example, the boundary of the strip rather than the crack texture itself) that is currently insufficient for tight localization.
blocks.zh: CBAM注意的解释. 虽然清晰的注意地图可视化留待未来工作使用,但每类结果可以间接证明注意模块学到了什么. 相对于其他类的补丁和划痕的强效性能,以及滚入尺度在YOLOv11m之上的边际优势,表明7 × \ 7 空间注意力的演化获得了定向选择性反应,非常适合长而方向性的缺陷纹理. 与此相对照,Crazing上的近随机性能与整个图像广泛激活的空间注意力一致,不会在RPN前端提供本地化信号. 图6中的定性检测实例证实了这一点:疯狂的图像显示的是分散的过度建议,而不是单一的紧凑本地化,与分散的空间注意一致。 定性的注意图分析可以确认这个假说,或者揭示注意模块找到一个紧凑的用于疯狂的代理信号(例如,条纹的边界而不是裂缝纹理本身),这种信号目前不足以进行紧凑的局部化.

blocks.en: The Extended Training Paradox. The 200-epoch TEEP-RCNN run with class-conditional loss weights achieves a best mAP@50 of 0.685 at epoch 42, which is below the primary 10-epoch model at 0.733. This counter-intuitive result has a plausible explanation: the crazing weight of 3.0 redirects gradient updates toward a class that the attention module fundamentally struggles with (as evidenced by the 0.099 per-class mAP), causing the model to spend gradient budget on signals that do not improve detection quality. Meanwhile, the well-performing classes (patches, scratches, pitted surface) receive relatively lower effective gradients, causing their class-specific heads to slightly deteriorate. The takeaway is that class weighting strategies need to be proportional to the model’s trainable capacity for each class, not just the class frequency imbalance.
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2018-09-29). The Extended Training Paradox. 200世纪TEEP-RCNN运行时带有类条件减重,在第42世纪达到0.685的最好mAP@50,低于0.733的初级10世纪模型. 这种反直觉的结果有一个合理的解释:3.0的疯狂的重量将梯度更新重心转向了关注模块根本与之相争的类(如每类mAP0.099的证明),导致模型将梯度预算花在没有提高检测质量的信号上. 同时,表现良好的类(斑点,划痕,坑底表面)得到相对较低的有效梯度,导致其特定类头稍有恶化. 取走的是,阶级加权策略需要与模型对每个阶层的可训练能力成正比,而不仅仅是阶级频率的不平衡.

blocks.en: Localization Precision and the mAP@50-95 Gap. The difference in mAP@50-95 between TEEP-RCNN (0.379) and YOLOv11m (0.450) is real but partially attributable to training duration. The regression branch of Faster R-CNN typically requires more epochs than the classification branch to converge, because tight box coordinates require the model to learn fine-grained offsets from anchor templates rather than just binary class decisions. At 10 epochs, the regression head has not fully exploited the precision afforded by RoI Align. Deformable convolutions [ 22 ] in the RoI head could partially compensate by learning geometric offsets that better fit non-rectangular defect shapes such as rolled-in scale and elongated scratches.
blocks.zh: 本地化精度与mAP@50-95差距. TPEE-RCNN(0.379)和YOLOv11m(0.450)之间的mAP@50-95差异是真实的,但部分归因于培训期限。 Fraild R-CNN的回归分支通常需要比分类分支更划时代来汇合,因为紧凑的框坐标需要模型从锚定模板中学习精细的纹理抵消,而不仅仅是二进制类决定. 在10世纪,回归头还没有充分利用RoI Align提供的精度. RoI头部的变形折射[22]可以通过学习几何抵消来部分补偿,这些抵消更适合非矩形的缺陷形状,如滚入尺度和延长的划痕.

blocks.en: The Case for Two-Stage Detectors in Industrial Inspection. The debate between two-stage and single-stage detectors in industrial settings often centers on inference speed. However, for offline quality control (post-production inspection rather than real-time line monitoring), inference speed is secondary to detection accuracy and false-negative rate. Two-stage detectors offer an interpretable proposal-then-classify pipeline where the RPN score distribution can be monitored independently of the classification confidence, and where the spatial attention module provides a natural mechanism for visualizing which regions the network considers defect-relevant. These properties are valuable in regulated manufacturing contexts where model decisions need to be auditable.
blocks.zh: 《工业检查双层探测器案》。 工业环境中的两阶段和单阶段探测器之间的争论往往以推论速度为中心。 然而,对于离线质量控制(生产后检查而不是实时线路监测),推论速度对于检测精度和假负率是次要的. 两级探测器提供了一个可解释的、当时分类的管道,其中RPN的分数分布可独立于分类信心加以监测,空间注意模块为可视化网络认为与缺陷有关的哪些区域提供了一个自然机制。 这些特性在受管制的制造业环境中很有价值,其中示范决定需要可审计。

blocks.en: VII Limitations
blocks.zh: 七. 限制

blocks.en: Parameter Count. TEEP-RCNN has 61.8 million parameters, substantially more than YOLOv11m’s 20.1 million. The majority of this overhead comes from the ResNet-101 backbone depth. For edge deployment scenarios where memory and latency matter, a lighter backbone such as ResNet-50 or MobileNetV3 would be necessary, and the impact of the improved CBAM in a lighter backbone setting is an open question.
blocks.zh: 参数计数. TEEP-RCN有6180万个参数,大大超过YOLOv11m的2010万. 大部分间接费用来自ResNet-101主干线深度。 对于存在内存和内存问题的边缘部署情景,需要一种较轻的骨干,如ResNet-50或MobileNetV3,改进后的CBAM在较轻骨干环境下的影响是一个未决问题。

blocks.en: Crazing Detection. The per-class mAP of 0.099 for crazing is well below the other five classes. The standard bounding box annotation format does not naturally represent the distributed texture structure of crazing, and the anchor-based proposal mechanism of Faster R-CNN is poorly suited to defects that have no compact spatial centroid. A segmentation-based auxiliary branch or a texture-specific detection head is likely needed to address this class adequately.
blocks.zh: 疯狂的检测。 用于crazing的每类mAP为0.099,远低于其他5类. 标准边框注解格式并不自然代表疯狂的分布式纹理结构,更快R-CNN的锚定式建议机制也非常适合没有紧凑的空间中间体的缺陷. 可能需要一个基于分解的辅助分支或一个特定纹理的检测头来适当处理这一类.

blocks.en: Absence of Ablation. The primary contribution is the improved CBAM module, but a controlled ablation comparing standard CBAM against improved CBAM on the same backbone and training schedule was not performed. The improvement over the vanilla Faster R-CNN baseline is demonstrated, but the specific contribution of the dropout versus the BatchNorm modification is not isolated. Such an ablation would require at least four experimental runs, which is left for a follow-up study.
blocks.zh: 离诸障障. 主要贡献是改进的CBAM模块,但是没有在同一主干和培训时间表上将标准CBAM与改进的CBAM进行比较。 这表明比香草更快R-CNN基线有所改善,但辍学与BatchNorm修改的具体贡献并不是孤立的。 这种消减至少需要四次试验,留待后续研究。

blocks.en: Single Dataset. All experiments are conducted on NEU-DET. The generalizability of the improved CBAM module to other industrial defect datasets, such as magnetic tile defects or printed circuit board inspection, has not been verified. The module’s behavior may differ on datasets with finer spatial resolution, more complex background textures, or a larger number of defect classes.
blocks.zh: 单数据集. 所有实验都是在NEU-DET上进行的. 改进后的CBAM模块与其他工业缺陷数据集的通用性,如磁瓦缺陷或印刷电路板检查,尚未得到核实. 模块在空间分辨率更细,背景纹理更复杂的数据集上的行为可能有所不同,或者存在较多的缺陷类.

blocks.en: No Inference Timing. Inference throughput on the test hardware was not measured in this study. Two-stage detectors are generally slower than single-stage ones, and a rigorous latency comparison on the Tesla T4 platform would be necessary before claiming deployment parity with YOLO-based solutions.
blocks.zh: 无推论定时. 本研究没有衡量测试硬件的推论吞吐量。 两级探测器一般比单级探测器慢,在声称部署与基于YOLO的解决方案相当之前,有必要对Tesla T4平台进行严格的延迟比较。

blocks.en: VIII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 八 结论

blocks.en: This paper presented TEEP-RCNN, a two-stage steel surface defect detector that integrates an improved Convolutional Block Attention Module into the Faster R-CNN framework. The improved CBAM adds dropout regularization to the channel attention MLP and batch normalization to the spatial attention branch, addressing two regularization weaknesses in the original design that are especially consequential on small industrial datasets. A differential learning rate protocol with cosine annealing warm-up preserves the ImageNet-pretrained backbone representations throughout training, and a WBF-TTA inference pipeline improves localization consistency on elongated defects.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍了TEEP-RCNN,一种双级钢质表面缺陷探测器,将经过改进的Convolutional Block Recent Module纳入更快的R-CNN框架. 改进后的CBAM将辍学正规化增加了信道注意力MLP和批量正常化增加了空间注意力分支,解决了最初设计中两个规范化的弱点,这些弱点对小型工业数据集的影响尤为严重。 采用异位的学习速率协议,加冕暖热,在整个培训过程中保留了ImageNet预先训练的骨干表示,而WBF-TTA推论管道则在长缺陷上提高本地化一致性.

blocks.en: Evaluated on NEU-DET, TEEP-RCNN achieves 73.3% mAP@50 in only 10 training epochs, closing to within 3 percentage points of YOLOv11m trained for 100 epochs. On the rolled-in-scale class, TEEP-RCNN (0.287 mAP) outperforms YOLOv11m (0.277 mAP), providing evidence that the spatial attention branch is particularly suited to elongated industrial defect morphology. The counter-intuitive result that the 200-epoch run with class weighting performs below the 10-epoch baseline highlights a practical lesson about the interaction between class weighting and pre-trained attention modules.
blocks.zh: 评估NEU-DET,TEEP-RCNN实现 73.3%的mAP@50只出现在10个培训时代,接近100个培训时代的YOLOv11m的3个百分点。 在缩放级上,TEEP-RCNN(0.287 mAP)的性能超过了YOLOv11m(0.277 mAP),提供了空间注意力分支特别适合延长的工业缺陷形态的证据. 反直观的结果是,带有类加权功能的200个纪元运行在10个纪元基线以下,这凸显了一个关于类加权与预训关注模块之间相互作用的实际教训.

blocks.en: Looking ahead, there are three concrete directions for extending this work. First, a formal ablation study isolating the dropout and BatchNorm contributions would clarify which modification drives the improvement. Second, integrating a segmentation auxiliary branch for the crazing class specifically, where bounding box localization is fundamentally ill-posed, would address the single largest per-class performance gap. Third, exploring the improved CBAM module within a lighter backbone such as ResNet-50 or MobileNetV2 would expand the practical applicability of the approach to resource-constrained edge devices common in production environments.
blocks.zh: 展望未来,扩大这项工作有三个具体方向。 首先,一项正式的废除研究将辍学和BatchNorm捐款隔离开来,将澄清哪些修改推动了改进。 第二,将一个分块辅助分支具体地纳入到疯狂类中,在捆绑箱本地化根本上存在漏洞的地方,将解决每类单项最大的性能差距. 第三,在ResNet-50或MobileNetV2等较轻的主干范围内探索改进后的CBAM模块,将扩大生产环境中常见的受资源限制的边缘装置的实际适用性。
